column3: “Dimmed” is rendered “dark,” and “stones of holiness” as “sacred stones … poured out.”
The written text has “like ostriches” in an unusual form; NASB follows the reading tradition.
“Crimson” is rendered “purple,” and “ash heaps” as “ash pits.”
“Not they twisted on her hands” is rendered “no hands were turned toward her.”
“Bright ones of high rank” is rendered “consecrated ones,” and “sapphire” as “lapis lazuli.”
“People called out to them” is rendered “they cried of themselves.”
“Not they lifted up the face” is rendered “did not honor.”
“It will finish” is rendered “The punishment … has been completed.”
